title: Pipeline Checkpoint
description: Full resumable snapshot after each pipeline stage.

stage.description: Stage name — validated at runtime against the pipeline manifest's stage list

artifacts.description: Map of artifact name to artifact data or file path

review.description: Reviewer output for this stage. `question` and `blockers` are read by the launcher and shown to the human AT the gate — anything needing an answer before approval must be here, not only in the agent's turn text, which the launcher never sees.

question.description: The question for the human at this gate, in their words. Replaces the launcher's generic 'Approve <stage>, or request a revision.' when present.

blockers.description: Findings the human must weigh before approving. Surfaced verbatim at the gate, critical first.

partial_progress.description: Live within-stage progress marker. During assets/compose the launcher reads partial_progress.phase (e.g. 'stills', 'motion_sample', 'budget_hold') top-level to resolve the correct within-stage gate.
